necessary_constructions: A,B,C = construct_ieq_triangle_q(2), D = construct_foot(B,C,A), E = construct_angle_clockwise(D,C,2*pi/3), E = construct_lc_tangent(A,C)
proof:
Solution:
1. Perpendicular(A,C,A,E) & Perpendicular(A,C,B,D) => Parallel(A,E,B,D)
2. Collinear(A,C,D) => Angle_B_A_C - Angle_B_A_D & Angle_A_D_E + Angle_C_D_E - pi & Parallel(A,C,A,D)
3. EquilateralTriangle(A,B,C) => Angle_B_A_C - pi/3 & IsoscelesTriangle(A,B,C)
4. Angle_B_A_C - Angle_B_A_D & Angle_A_D_E + Angle_C_D_E - pi & Angle_B_A_C - pi/3 & Angle_C_D_E - 2*pi/3 => Angle_A_D_E - Angle_B_A_D
5. Perpendicular(A,C,A,E) & Parallel(A,C,A,D) => Perpendicular(A,D,A,E)
6. Perpendicular(A,D,A,E) => Angle_D_A_E - pi/2
7. Perpendicular(A,C,B,D) & Parallel(A,C,A,D) => Perpendicular(A,D,B,D)
8. Perpendicular(A,D,B,D) => Angle_A_D_B - pi/2
9. Angle_D_A_E - pi/2 & Angle_A_D_B - pi/2 => Angle_A_D_B - Angle_D_A_E
10. -Angle_A_D_E + Angle_B_A_D & Angle_A_D_B - Angle_D_A_E => Congruent3(A,B,D,D,E,A)
11. Congruent3(A,B,D,D,E,A) => Length_A_E - Length_B_D
12. Parallel(A,E,B,D) & Length_A_E - Length_B_D => Parallelogram(A,D,B,E)
13. Parallelogram(A,D,B,E) => Length_A_D - Length_B_E
14. Length_A_B - 2 & Length_B_C - 2 => Length_A_B - Length_B_C
15. IsoscelesTriangle(A,B,C) & Length_A_B - Length_B_C & Collinear(A,C,D) & Perpendicular(A,C,B,D) => Midpoint(D,A,C)
16. Midpoint(D,A,C) => Length_A_C - 2*Length_A_D
17. Length_A_C - 2*Length_A_D & Length_A_C - 2 => Length_A_D - 1
18. Length_A_D - Length_B_E & Length_A_D - 1 => Length_B_E - 1
